correctness.rationale: For each of three coordinate-pair line families, fourth root equations u^4=-b/a etc produce 12 distinct theta-contact lines. The 16 lines X=uY+vZ with u^4=b/a,v^4=c/a satisfy an explicit perfect-square restriction identity, valid also in characteristic 3. The 28 lines are distinct, and the classical genus-three odd-theta-characteristic count exhausts them in characteristic not two (hyperflex tangents included). For q≡1 mod4, Frobenius acts on each fourth-root torsor by additive shift of exponent r, s, s-r plus epsilon for -1, and acts diagonally on 16 two-parameter lines, yielding exact orbit profile and all extension-field fixed-point counts. For q≡3 mod4, quadratic characters give four rational lines and all fourth roots lie in F_(q^2), forcing 1^4 2^12. Finite arithmetic checks directly enumerated all rational projective lines and binary-quartic square restrictions in p=3,5,7,11,13, and checked 16 residue patterns for each congruence; 100 cases passed without treating finite sampling as all-field proof.

originality.rationale: Qualified PASS: the 12+16 Fermat-quartic geometric bitangent decomposition and group action are classical, and Meagher–Top already classify Dyck–Fermat twists and Frobenius of Jacobians. The read full source has no bitangent calculation (a text search of all 26 pages found no occurrence), and Bethea–Brazelton's 12+16 complex automorphism action does not explicitly derive the coefficientwise arithmetic Frobenius cycle table including q≡3 mod4 and characteristic 3. The complete orbit table is a modest but natural arithmetic extraction; generic twist/Galois group action may make it easily derivable and prior specialist literature may already contain it.
residual_risks: Classical action of the Fermat automorphism group on all 28 bitangents combined with twist classification might already yield the profiles as a known corollary in another Galois-theta reference.
Some finite-field literature treats rational contact points rather than rational bitangent lines; counts must not be conflated.
In characteristic 3 the 28 theta lines exist with hyperflex intersections; do not assume generic 56 distinct geometric contact points.

value.rationale: PASS: arithmetic splitting and rational bitangent counts control field-of-definition questions on a natural genus-three family. The explicit all-odd-field cycle profile and finite-étale zeta include hyperflexes and extend classical 28-line geometric enumeration to arithmetic fields; one can need exact extension degrees rather than just the geometric line set. The result is not advertised as a classification of arbitrary quartics.

final_claim: All 28 theta-contact bitangent lines of every smooth diagonal aX^4+bY^4+cZ^4 over odd F_q have explicitly classified Frobenius orbit lengths. q≡3 mod4 always profile 1^4 2^12. For q≡1 mod4, fourth-power residue classes (r,s) and epsilon for q mod8 give three 4-line translation shifts plus a 16-line (Z/4)^2 translation; extension counts and zeta follow.
limitations: No characteristic-two or arbitrary non-diagonal quartic classification; finite-etale zeta is for bitangent scheme, not Hasse–Weil zeta of the genus-three curve.
